definition: Gene therapy is a biological approach that aims to improve disease by delivering a working gene into affected cells so they can make the needed protein. In this source, it refers to AAV-mediated gene augmentation that introduced human L-opsin cDNA into cone cells and restored retinal structure and function in a mouse model.
